name: scoped-approve
description: Approves without asking only the shell commands on an exact allow-list (arguments only where an entry ends in *); never overrides a deny, never touches subagents

allowList.title: Allowed commands
allowList.description: Comma-separated. An entry matches only the identical command; end it with a space and * to also accept arguments, e.g. git status, npm test *

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the auto-approval off without uninstalling
